title: Virga JWST-range solar-composition cloud forward sensitivity sweep

protocol.name: Virga solar-composition JWST-range forward sensitivity sweep
protocol.temperature_interpolation: tabulated linear in log10 pressure, no extrapolation
protocol.cloud_inventory: Each installed Virga2.0.2 solar gas_properties default at the profile's Virga MMW; record physical gas mass ratio g/g and reference. Single-species cases; no sum of competing elemental reservoirs.
protocol.cloud_mmw_policy: Median complete FastChem MMW per profile for Virga only; ROBERT gas/RT retains original pressure-dependent MMW.

mie.radius_grid: Virga default60 radii; verify exact grid and distribution support

radiative_transfer.emission: thermal emission, SH4 HG closure for both cloudy and clear; no reflected stellar beam
radiative_transfer.transmission: spherical-shell extinction, constant gravity, impact quadrature6
radiative_transfer.hminus: Include equilibrium H-,H,e- through supported continuum after alias validation

protocol.interpretation: Controlled forward differences at prescribed TP and solar gas; no radiative-convective feedback or coupled cloud gas depletion. Not retrieval constraints or observational detectability.
required_checks: conditional parameter ranges at fixed other controls
WASP15b PNG/PDF visual QA, deterministic model-range labels

HyVO_R1000.reason: Local R1000 file has inconsistent header: irec0=5221 allows 5116 wavelength records but header declares5119. Rejected without altering source or applying a reader exception.

vo_opacity.selection: New official download; validated alternative after malformed HyVO header rejection.

producer.invalid_reason: VirgaInvalidProposalError: fall-speed constraint would require particles smaller than gas atoms; preserved as invalid proposals.

rejected_alternative.reason: Local R1000 file has inconsistent header: irec0=5221 allows 5116 wavelength records but header declares5119. Rejected without altering source or applying a reader exception.

catalogue.catalogue_license: AGPL-3.0; see LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt in the optical-constant snapshot

result_summary.interpretation: All requested rows are accounted for. Virga rejected 18 physical settings; the runner did not replace them with clear cases. Completion means calculated, not scientifically validated.

maximum_fiducial_width_response.note: The saved range table records the peak span, but it does not record the wavelength coordinate.

support_criteria.mie: All condensate-layer effective radii inside Mie center extrema and condensate-pressure-weighted area/mass tails <=1%; cloud-free cases retained.
support_criteria.top_tau: Optional exploratory display filter: maximum top-layer vertical cloud optical depth <0.01. This is not a grid-convergence test and does not imply optically thin slant paths.

mie_support_checks_only.criterion: All condensate-layer effective radii inside Mie center extrema and condensate-pressure-weighted area/mass tails <=1%; cloud-free cases retained.

mie_checks_and_top_vertical_tau_below_0p.criterion: All condensate-layer effective radii inside Mie center extrema and condensate-pressure-weighted area/mass tails <=1%; cloud-free cases retained. AND Optional exploratory display filter: maximum top-layer vertical cloud optical depth <0.01. This is not a grid-convergence test and does not imply optically thin slant paths.

saved_product_verifier.scope: saved-product verification only; no forward model, RT, or retrieval calls

captions.fiducial_spectral_effects: Absolute cloud-minus-matched-clear eclipse-depth change for emission and transit-depth change for transmission at fsed=1, log10(Kzz)=9, and geometric standard deviation 2. Top row is emission; bottom row is transmission. Columns are cool, reference, and hot T–P profiles. Curves are deterministic forward-model outputs; they are not posterior medians or intervals.
captions.fsed_conditional_response: For each fixed log$_{10}$ K$_{zz}$ (cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$), the color is the maximum over wavelength of the max-minus-min fsed cloud depth change at geometric standard deviation 2, computed over supported parameter values when at least two states are available. Cells labeled n/N show the number of supported parameter values out of the expected count; 0/N is masked and 1/N has no range estimate. Partial ranges and per-dex values use the actual supported interval only. See conditional_parameter_ranges.csv for supported, missing, and physical-invalid values. Emission uses absolute eclipse-depth change; transmission uses absolute transit-depth change. Rows are emission and transmission; columns are cool, reference, and hot T–P profiles. These deterministic ranges are not local derivatives, Fisher information, or posterior intervals.
captions.grid_max_impact: Maximum absolute cloud–matched-clear depth change over completed, physically supported fsed, log10(Kzz), and width states. Expected physical-invalid proposals are excluded from the maximum and remain in the status ledger; grid_wide_ranges.csv records supported and invalid counts. A masked cell means that no supported spectrum exists for that profile and condensate. Emission is absolute eclipse-depth change; transmission is absolute transit-depth change. Rows are emission and transmission; columns are cool, reference, and hot T–P profiles. Each geometry row has its own logarithmic color scale. This is a grid maximum, not a posterior interval or one-at-a-time response.

interpretation_limits.scope: Deterministic cloud-minus-clear forward differences at prescribed T-P profiles and solar equilibrium gas composition. Not retrieval posterior constraints, observational detectability estimates, or radiative-convective results.
interpretation_limits.raw_maxima: The six global raw maxima are not filtered by Mie-radius support or top-layer diagnostics. Some peak cases exceed center or outer-bin support. Treat these raw extremes as sensitivity flags, not robust physical predictions.
interpretation_limits.support: Effective-radius and lognormal-tail flags are diagnostics. They overlap and do not remove calculated spectra from the raw grid.
interpretation_limits.upper_boundary: The study uses do_virtual=false. It reports top-layer condensate and optical depth. Some transit spectra approach the opaque upper-edge bound; this does not establish independent cloud-base validation.
interpretation_limits.cloud_chemistry: Each cloud species runs alone. Cloud depletion is not coupled back into FastChem. The Virga-only median MMW override differs from the pressure-dependent gas/RT MMW.
interpretation_limits.radiative_transfer: SH4/Henyey-Greenstein scattering is used for emission only. Transmission uses spherical-shell cloud extinction, not a multiple-scattering transit solver.
interpretation_limits.resolution: Input KTA tables are R1000. The calculated grid has 300 logarithmic bins over 0.6-12 micron and retains all 20 native g ordinates; its effective resolution is nominal R100.
interpretation_limits.product_counts: Spectral-product counts refer to saved state/geometry products, not distinct numerical spectra. Zero-condensate cases can match clear spectra exactly. Calculated states are not all scientifically validated.
